lab: Class 10 - Stored XSS (Your words run in someone else's browser)
author: Chen Ziming (CHU 2023905333)

flaw_10_stored_xss.attacker: prof.turing (teacher) - the only role allowed to write grade comments
flaw_10_stored_xss.fix: Removed the {% autoescape false %} wrapper in both templates; each line became {{ n.comment }}. Templates are COPYed into the image, so the stack was rebuilt with docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.windows.yml up -d --build.

after_fix_same_stored_row.image_check: docker exec noteapp-web-1 grep -rn 'autoescape false' /app/templates/ -> no match (exit 1)

tests.command: python -m pytest -q --cov=web --cov-report=term-missing (project container, repository mounted at /work, TEST_DB_HOST=db)
tests.new: tests/test_stored_xss.py - the student dashboard and the teacher table deliver the payload as escaped text and never as a live <script>; a normal comment keeps < and &; a guard test fails if any template in the Jinja search path contains 'autoescape false'
tests.environment_note: The suite normally runs on the host against PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:15432. On this Windows host the temporary directory was unusable during verification, so the identical tests were run in a throwaway container with the repository mounted.

data_integrity.note_1: still owned by alice (user id 6); now carries the Part 4 comment and grade 11.0; the comment is stored as aesgcm:v1: ciphertext (90 bytes)
data_integrity.note: Escaping changes rendering only; storage was not touched by this fix.

residual_risks: No Content-Security-Policy or nonce is set anywhere (base.html, app.py); a policy would not have stopped this inline script either.
/api/notes/<id> returns the comment as JSON; the dashboard writes it with textContent, but any client assigning it to innerHTML would reintroduce the flaw on another path.
That the script runs with alice's session is measured at execution level (same-origin inline script inside her page). Cookie theft or a forged grade POST as alice was not attempted.
Other teaching flaws remain untouched (e.g. #11 missing CSRF on the grade POST, #13 container runs as root with the Docker socket mounted).
predictions_recorded: See prediction.md - written before the run: it runs; inert after the fix; a normal comment is unaffected.
